curatedMovie.curiosityHook: In the chaos outside the embassy gates, was opening fire a catastrophic misjudgment or a grim tactical necessity under siege?
curatedMovie.description: When an American embassy in Yemen is surrounded by demonstrators, a Marine Colonel orders his unit to open fire—triggering a high-stakes court-martial over military command and deadly force.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, tense, and morally fraught; a measured legal drama wrapped in volatile military suspense.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by William Friedkin, this military courtroom thriller delivers a tense, heavyweight clash between combat split-second judgment and rigid legal accountability.
